releaseNotes:
🚀 Major Stability & Chat Perfection Release (v1.2.0) by Dhiraj:
• 🛡️ Zero Duplicate Messages: Advanced mathematical deduplication prevents duplicate chat notifications across WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram & Messages.
• 🎯 Default Smart Monitoring: Automatically saves WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram & SMS by default. All other apps stay disabled until you choose.
• 🎬 Direct Instagram Reels URLs: Captures direct canonical Reel links (instagram.com/reel/<id>/) rather than generic navigation.
• 🖼️ WhatsApp Real Profile Photos: Displays real circular profile photos in chat threads and headers, with initial fallback.
• ⚡ Seamless Native Installer: External cache staging prevents package parsing errors.
• 🔒 100% Data Preservation: All existing messages, media, and keys remain completely intact.
